The golden '''six-pointed star''' ornament is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] as a part of her [[paralis-net]].

==Appearance==
A six-pointed star-shaped trinket, pending from a golden hair needle.

==Use==
When triggered it forms a thin "armor" against the skin of the wearer. This protection is invisible except to whoever is using it. It protects against the blows of swords, knifes, arrows and even maces because it dissipates the force of the blow over the entire body, thus reducing it.

==Parallels==
The six-pointed star is known as the [[wikipedia:Seal of Solomon|Seal of Solomon]] in Islam and acts a protective charm. In Judaism, the [[wikipedia:Star of David|Star of David]], which is a symbol of Judaism and the Jewish people.
